The Democratic Party is poised to win at least 54 seats in the US Senate, and could win up to 250 seats in the House of Representatives, marking a huge turnaround for the party's fortunes from the lows of 2024. In a strong repudiation of US President Donald J. Trump, the American electorate in long-held Republican states flipped to vote Democratic. Keshav Padmanabhan breaks down the results.
